actions.name: create_cart
actions.description: Create cart. Creates a cart.  ### Cart ownership  When an app or a Wix user creates a cart, specify `customerInfo.memberId` or `customerInfo.visitorId` to make that member or visitor the cart's owner. These fields are read-only after the cart is created.  When a site member or site visitor calls Create Cart directly, the caller always owns the cart. Create Cart ignores any owner GUID or `customerInfo.openAccess` value in the request.  For a customer who isn't identified yet, specify `customerInfo.openAccess` as `true`. The cart then has no owner, and the first site visitor, site member, or Wix user who accesses it becomes its owner.  If you specify neither an owner GUID nor `customerInfo....

cart.description: A shopping cart for a customer on a Wix eCommerce site.  A cart holds the customer's selected items, applied discounts (coupons, automatic rules), delivery information, and payment details before the order is placed.  Carts may be deleted after a period of inactivity.  Use the [Cart Service](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/purchase-flow/cart-v2/introduction.md) to manage carts by GUID, or the [Current Cart Service](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/purchase-flow/cart-v2/introduction.md) to manage the current customer's cart by session.

note.description: Optional message left by the customer. Usually intended for the merchant and contains special instructions, requests, or clarifications related to the order.

source.description: Information about the source of the Cart, detailing the origin or context in which the Cart was created.

channelType.description: Sales channel that created the cart.

customContentReference.description: App and component GUIDs for the custom checkout page content provider.

appId.description: App GUID for the checkout content provider. Find it in the [app dashboard](https://dev.wix.com/dc3/my-apps/).

componentId.description: Component GUID within that app. Find it in the [app dashboard](https://dev.wix.com/dc3/my-apps/).

businessInfo.description: Information about the site from which the Cart's line items were added.

locationId.description: Business location GUID for the cart. See the [Locations API](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/business-management/locations/introduction.md).

customerInfo.description: Information about the customer that owns the Cart.

vatId.description: Business VAT registration number.

type.description: Tax type.  Supported values: + `CPF`: for individual tax payers + `CNPJ`: for corporations

deliveryInfo.description: Delivery-related information associated with the Cart.

subdivision.description: Code for a subdivision (such as state, prefecture, or province) in [ISO 3166-2](https://www.iso.org/standard/72483.html) format.

addressLine.description: Main address line (usually street name and number).

addressLine2.description: Free text providing more detailed address info. Usually contains apt, suite, floor.

geocode.description: Geocode object containing latitude and longitude coordinates.

taxInfo.description: Tax-related information associated with the Cart.

taxExemptGroupId.description: Tax-exempt group GUID applied for tax exemptions.

paymentInfo.description: Payment-related information associated with the Cart.

vatId.description: Tax information (for Brazil only). If GUID is provided, `vatId.type` must also be set, `UNSPECIFIED` is not allowed.

sitePaymentMethodTypeId.description: GUID of the site payment method type the customer selected to pay with. See the [Site Payment Method Types API](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/payments/site-payment-method-types/introduction.md).

customCheckoutUrl.description: Custom checkout URL to redirect the customer to a checkout page. By default, customers are redirected to the standard Wix checkout page. Clients can override this behavior by providing their own URL here. If the URL contains the placeholder `{checkout_id}`, it will be replaced with the actual Cart GUID.

extendedFields.description: Custom fields. [Extended fields](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/articles/getting-started/extended-fields.md) must be configured in the app dashboard before they can be accessed with API calls.

namespaces.description: Extended field data. Each key corresponds to the namespace of the app that created the extended fields. coupons.description: Coupons to apply. Currently only one is supported.

rootCatalogItemId.description: When `catalogReference.catalogItemId` isn't the actual catalog item GUID, this field returns the true catalog item GUID. inventoryAppId.description: GUID of the app managing inventory.

url.description: URL of the item's page on the site.

relativePath.description: The relative path for the page within the site. For example, `/product-page/a-product`.

url.description: The page's full URL. For example, `https://mysite.com/product-page/a-product`.

itemType.description: Item type: preset or custom.

custom.description: Custom item type. When none of the preset types are suitable, specifies the custom type.

physicalProperties.description: Physical properties of the item. When relevant, includes SKU, weight, and shippability.

serviceProperties.description: Service properties. When relevant, includes date and number of participants.

scheduledDate.description: Date and time the service is to be provided, in [ISO-8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Combined_date_and_time_representations) format. For example, the start time of a class.

numberOfParticipants.description: The number of people participating in the service. For example, the number of people attending a class or the number of people per hotel room.

membersOnly.description: Whether the item can only be purchased by site members.  Default: `false`

frequency.description: Frequency of recurring payment.

interval.description: Interval of recurring payment.  Default: `1`. If SubscriptionFrequency is Day the minimum interval is 7

autoRenewal.description: Whether subscription is renewed automatically at the end of each period.

billingCycles.description: Number of billing cycles before subscription ends. Ignored if `autoRenewal` is `true`.

enableCustomerCancellation.description: Whether to allow the customer to cancel the subscription.

freeTrialPeriod.description: Period until first cycle starts. If applied payNow will be 0 If None => no free trial

frequency.description: Frequency of period. Values: DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR

interval.description: Number of frequency units in the free trial period. For example, frequency `MONTH` with interval `3` means a 3-month free trial.

startDate.description: Date and time the subscription starts.  The first charge happens when the order is placed. When `freeTrialPeriod` is set, the first charge happens when the free trial ends.

anchorDay.description: Day of the month that recurring charges fall on. For example, `15` to charge on the 15th of each month.  Used only when the subscription's `frequency` is `MONTH` and `interval` is `1`.

original.description: Subscription option name in the site's default language as defined in the [request envelope](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/frameworks/self-hosting/supported-extensions/backend-extensions/add-self-hosted-service-plugin-extensions.md#request-envelope).

translated.description: Subscription option name translated into the buyer's language.  Default: Same as `original`.

translated.description: Translated subscription option description.

taxConfig.description: Tax configuration for the line item.

addressType.description: taxable address type. if this field is selected, the address is automatically resolved, and the tax is calculated accordingly.

paymentConfig.description: Payment configuration for the line item.

depositAmount.description: Partial payment due upfront during checkout. Only when `paymentOption` is `DEPOSIT_ONLINE`.

modifierGroups.description: Modifier groups added to the item.

modifiers.description: Modifiers in this group.

redeemAmount.description: The amount requested to redeem from this gift card.

cart.description: A shopping cart for a customer on a Wix eCommerce site.  A cart holds the customer's selected items, applied discounts (coupons, automatic rules), delivery information, and payment details before the order is placed.  Carts may be deleted after a period of inactivity.  Use the [Cart Service](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/purchase-flow/cart-v2/introduction.md) to manage carts by GUID, or the [Current Cart Service](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/purchase-flow/cart-v2/introduction.md) to manage the current customer's cart by session.

note.description: Optional message left by the customer. Usually intended for the merchant and contains special instructions, requests, or clarifications related to the order.

actions.name: estimate_cart
actions.description: Estimate cart. Estimates cart totals from the cart's current state and selected calculation components.  Provides a partial, component-based estimate for preview (for example, partial estimated totals). Boolean flags control which components are included: delivery costs, additional fees, taxes, and gift cards. Components that aren't enabled are excluded. Line item discounts are already applied to the cart.  This isn't a full cart calculation.

calculateAdditionalFees.description: Whether to calculate additional fees.  Default: `false`.

calculateDelivery.description: Whether to calculate delivery costs.  Default: `false`.

calculateGiftCards.description: Whether to include the effect of gift card balances on the cart total. Gift cards aren't redeemed; balances are reflected for estimation only.  Default: `false`.

refreshCart.description: Whether to retrieve the latest item prices, discounts, and inventory data from the catalogs before estimating the cart.  Default: `false`.

actions.name: estimate_current_cart
actions.description: Estimate current cart. Estimates the customer's current cart totals based on its current state and the selected calculation components.  This API provides a partial, component-based estimation of the cart and is intended for preview purposes (for example, showing partial estimated totals).  The estimation is controlled by boolean flags that indicate which components should be included (delivery costs, additional fees, taxes, gift cards). Components that aren't explicitly enabled are excluded from the calculation.  This isn't a full cart calculation.  Note that line item discounts are already pre-computed and applied to the current cart.

calculateAdditionalFees.description: Whether to calculate any additional fees. Default: `false`.

calculateDelivery.description: Whether to calculate delivery costs. Default: `false`.

calculateGiftCards.description: Whether to calculate the effect of gift card balances on the cart total. Gift cards aren't redeemed - only reflected for estimation purposes. Default: `false`.

calculateTax.description: Whether to include tax calculation. Default: `false`.

refreshCart.description: Whether to retrieve the latest item prices, discounts, and inventory data from the catalogs before estimating the cart.  Default: `false`.

media.description: Custom line item's media.

productName.description: Name of the item or product.

itemType.description: Item type. Either a preset type or custom.

physicalProperties.description: Physical properties of the item.

Defaults to `FULL_PAYMENT_ONLINE`.  + `FULL_PAYMENT_ONLINE` - Entire payment for this item happens as part of the checkout. + `FULL_PAYMENT_OFFLINE` - Entire payment for this item happens after the checkout. For example, when using cash, check, or other offline payment methods. + `MEMBERSHIP` - Payment for this item is done by charging a membership. When this option is used, `lineItem.price.amount` is 0. + `DEPOSIT_ONLINE` -  Partial payment for the given item to be paid upfront during the checkout. Amount to be paid is defined by deposit_amount field.

scheduledDate.description: Date and time the service is to be provided, in [ISO-8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Combined_date_and_time_representations) format. For example, the start time of a class.

numberOfParticipants.description: The number of people participating in the service. For example, the number of people attending a class or the number of people per hotel room.

rootCatalogItemId.description: In cases where `catalogReference.catalogItemId` is NOT the actual catalog item GUID, this field will return the true item's GUID.  + For example, for Wix Bookings, `catalogReference.catalogItemId` is the booking GUID. Therefore this value is set to the service GUID. + In most cases, this field is the same as `catalogReference.catalogItemId`. + Used in membership validation.

priceUndetermined.description: Whether the price is not yet defined, and will be updated after the order is created.  Default: `false`

fixedQuantity.description: Whether the line item quantity is fixed and cannot be changed.  Default: `false`

policies.description: Policies to be displayed to the customer on the checkout page.

membersOnly.description: Whether the item can only be purchased by site members.  Default: `false`

taxableAddress.description: Address to use for tax calculation purposes.

addressType.description: taxable address type. if this field is selected, the address is automatically resolved, and the tax is calculated accordingly.

modifierGroups.description: Modifier groups that were added to the item.

customContentReference.description: Reference GUIDs for the app and component providing custom checkout page content. actions.name: query_checkout_templates
actions.description: Query checkout templates. Retrieves a list of checkout templates, given the provided paging, filtering, and sorting.  Query Checkout Templates runs with these defaults, which you can override: - `id` sorted in `ASC` order  The following table shows field support for filters and sorting for the checkout template object:  | Field              | Supported Filters                                         | Sortable | | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | | `id`               | `$eq`, `$ne`, `$in`, `$startsWith`, `$exists`, `$hasSome` | Sortable | | `status`           | `$eq`, `$ne`, `$in`, `$exists`, `$hasSome`                | Sortable |...

limit.description: Number of items to load.

cursor.description: Pointer to the next or previous page in the list of results. </ br>  You can get the relevant cursor token from the `pagingMetadata` object in the previous call's response. Not relevant for the first request.

filter.description: Filter object in the following format: `"filter" : { "fieldName1": "value1", "fieldName2":{"$operator":"value2"} }`  Example of operators: `$eq`, `$ne`, `$in`, `$startsWith`, `$exists`, `$hasSome`

sort.description: Sort object in the following format: `[{"fieldName":"sortField1","order":"ASC"},{"fieldName":"sortField2","order":"DESC"}]`

fieldName.description: Name of the field to sort by.

actions.name: create_and_redirect_to_checkout
actions.description: Create and redirect to checkout. Creates a new checkout based on the checkout template and redirects to the new checkout page.  Before using this method, you must have a checkout template available. Create a checkout template with Create Checkout Template.  To build a URL that uses this method, follow this format: `https://www.wixapis.com/ecom/v1/checkout-templates/{checkoutTemplateId}/create-and-redirect-to-checkout?siteId={siteId}`  To create a checkout but not automatically redirect to the checkout page, use Create Checkout From Template.

siteId.description: GUID of the site associated with the checkout template.

actions.name: create_checkout_from_template
actions.description: Create checkout from template. Creates a new checkout based on the checkout template.  Before using this method, you must have a checkout template available. Create a checkout template with Create Checkout Template.  The customer can be directed to the new checkout using the checkout's `checkoutUrl`.

siteId.description: GUID of the site associated with the checkout template.

actions.description: Delete abandoned checkout. Deletes an abandoned checkout.

To learn how to query abandoned checkouts, see [API Query Language](https://dev.wix.com/api/rest/getting-started/api-query-language).

actions.name: search_abandoned_checkouts

visible.description:
Whether the terms and conditions policy is visible to the customer in the checkout page.

Default: `false`

subscriptionCheckbox.description:
Subscription checkbox.

Controls the marketing consent checkbox shown to the buyer at checkout. By default, a single checkbox lets the buyer opt in to both email and SMS marketing at once. When `subscriptionCheckbox.splitByChannel` is `true`, checkout instead shows two separate checkboxes - one for email, one for SMS - so the buyer can opt into each channel independently.

Both checkboxes are always shown together - a buyer can't be shown just one channel. `checkedByDefault` applies to both checkboxes equally: when `true`, both start pre-checked.  Default: `false`

actions.name: create_order
actions.description: Create order. Creates an order.   Use this method to create manual orders for phone or email sales or to add orders from external systems (such as POS, marketplaces, or legacy platforms). For standard online purchases, orders are created automatically through the checkout flow.  To record payment information for the order, pass the order GUID to [Add Payments](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/orders/order-transactions/add-payments.md).  For apps that aren't yet published in the Wix App Market, Create Order is limited to 5 calls per hour per site.  > **Notes:** > + Inventory is automatically reduced when the order is placed (default) or when the order is...

order.description: An order represents a completed purchase from a buyer. Orders are created through the checkout flow or manually via the Create Order endpoint.  The order contains details about purchased items, buyer and recipient information, pricing, tax, shipping, fulfillment status, and payment status.  To get the total sum of all discounts applied to an order, use `priceSummary.discount.amount`.

actions.name: import_order
actions.description: Import order. Imports a single order together with its historical data, such as the original creation date, order number, and statuses.  Import Order is designed for migrating existing orders into a site from an external system, for example when a merchant moves from another eCommerce platform. Provide the complete order in the request. Wix stores the values you provide as-is and doesn't recalculate totals or statuses, so fields such as `priceSummary`, `balanceSummary`, and `fulfillmentStatus` reflect exactly what you send.  Unlike creating an order through the regular flow, importing an order doesn't trigger side effects: no notifications are sent to the buyer, inventory isn't adjusted, ...

order.description: An order represents a completed purchase from a buyer. Orders are created through the checkout flow or manually via the Create Order endpoint. Use `delayedCaptureSettings` to configure automatic behavior: - `CAPTURE`: Automatically charge the customer after the specified delay - `VOID`: Automatically release the hold after the specified delay  Alternatively, manually control the authorization using Capture Authorized Payments or Void Authorized Payments.  *Note**: The order must have a saved payment method. Check for `savedPaymentMethod: true` in...

actions.name: capture_authorized_payments
actions.description: Capture authorized payments. Captures (charges) previously authorized payments, converting the authorization hold into an actual charge. actions.name: charge_order
actions.description: Charge order. Charges payments for an order using one or more payment methods.  Supports charging through multiple payment methods in a single request: - **Regular payments**: Charges using the customer's payment method (credit card, PayPal, etc.). - **Gift cards**: Redeems gift card codes - **Memberships**: Charges membership credits or benefits for specific line items.  The method processes all specified payment types and returns the created payments along with the updated order transactions.  A successful charge returns payments with a `status` of `APPROVED`, `AUTHORIZED`, `PENDING`, or `PENDING_MERCHANT`. `PENDING` and `PENDING_MERCHANT` payments are confirmed asynchronously, so poll ...

giftCards.description: Gift card charges to apply to the order.

amount.description: Amount to charge from the gift card.

currencyConversionInfo.description: Details of the conversion from the gift card's currency to the order's currency.  Required if the order's currency differs from the gift card's currency.  When provided, the gift card is redeemed with `originalAmount`, otherwise with `amount`.

redirectUrls.description: Redirect URLs for the payment flow.

cancelUrl.description: URL to redirect the customer to when they cancel the payment process. Typically redirects back to the checkout or cart page.

errorUrl.description: URL to redirect the customer to when the payment fails or is rejected. Use this to show an error page with retry options or alternative payment methods.

pendingUrl.description: URL to redirect the customer to when the payment is still being processed. Some payment methods require additional time for confirmation or verification.

actions.name: get_order_refundability
actions.description: Get order refundability. Retrieves refund information about an order's payments, line items, shipping, and additional fees.  Returns detailed refundability status for each payment: - `refundable`: Automatic refund is available. - `manuallyRefundable`: Refund is expected to be processed externally. Can be manually marked as refunded. - `nonRefundable`: Refund cannot be performed.  Use this method before processing refunds to understand what can be refunded and through which method (automatic vs manual).

actions.name: redeem_gift_card
actions.description: Redeem gift card. Redeems a gift card as payment for an order by applying the gift card balance to the order total.  Creates a gift card payment transaction and deducts the specified amount from the gift card balance. The redeemed amount reduces the order's outstanding balance.  > **Note** > The following prerequisites apply: > + Gift card must be active and not expired. > + Gift card must have sufficient balance. > + Order must not be cancelled or fully paid. > + Gift card currency must match order currency.

currency.description: Currency code, in [ISO-4217](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217#List_of_ISO_4217_currency_codes) format.

orderId.description: Order GUID to apply the gift card payment to.

actions.name: refund_payments
actions.description: Refund payments. Processes payment refunds by calling payment providers and creating refund transactions.  Supports two refund methods: - **Automatic refunds**: Calls the payment provider's API to process the refund. - **External refunds**: Marks payments as refunded without calling providers (for manual provider-side refunds).  Set `paymentRefunds.externalRefund = true` for external refunds when you've manually processed the refund and only need to update the order's transaction records.  The method also handles restocking inventory and sending customer notifications when specified in `sideEffects`.

customerReason.description: Optional customer-provided reason for the refund for record-keeping purposes.

orderId.description: Order GUID to process refunds for.

paymentRefunds.description: Payment refunds specifying which payments to refund and their amounts. Set `externalRefund` to `true` for manual refunds processed outside the system.

paymentId.description: GUID of the payment to refund from the order's payment transactions.

amount.description: Amount to refund from this payment. Not applicable for membership payments and gift card refunds where the full credit is refunded.

externalRefund.description: Whether this refund is processed externally through the payment provider's dashboard.  + **Automatic refund** (`false`, default): Calls the payment provider's API to process the refund. The system handles the refund transaction and updates the payment status automatically.  + **External refund** (`true`): Marks the payment as refunded without calling the provider's API. Use this when you've manually processed the refund and only need to update the order records.

lineItems.description: Line items and their quantities to refund.

lineItemId.description: Line item GUID.

quantity.description: Quantity of this product to refund. Cannot exceed the available refund quantity for this line item.

customMessage.description: Custom message to include in the refund confirmation email sent to the customer. Use this to provide additional context about the refund, return instructions, or customer service information.

actions.name: void_authorized_payments

Use this method when you no longer need to capture an authorized payment, such as when an order is cancelled or when inventory becomes unavailable after authorization.  *Note**: Only payments with `AUTHORIZED` status can be voided. Already captured payments cannot be voided.

Reading the order immediately afterward may still show the previous payment status. > + If any payment's external transaction GUID already exists on the order, the entire call fails and no payments are added.

savedPaymentMethod.description: Whether there is a payment agreement that allows for future charges.

failureDetails.description: In case of status is FAILED may contain failure details

status.description: Status of this void action

failureDetails.description: In case of status is FAILED may contain failure details

chargebacks.description: Record of chargebacks made by the buyer.

buyerLanguageName.description: Payment method name in the buyer's language. For example, `"Credit/Debit Cards"`.

siteLanguageName.description: Payment method name in the site's language. For example, `"Credit/Debit Cards"`.  When no site-language name is stored, holds the same value as `buyerLanguageName`.

custom.description: Custom payment method name provided by user.  For example, `"Wire transfer"`, `"Money order"`, `"Venmo"` or any other custom name.

To update the status of a single payment, call [Update Payment Status](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/orders/order-transactions/update-payment-status.md).

actions.name: list_transactions_for_multiple_orders

actions.description: Update payment status. Updates the status of an order's payment.  This method only updates the payment record. It doesn't interact with the payment provider or move any funds.  > **Notes:** > + To issue a refund and update the payment status to refunded, use [Refund Payments](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/orders/order-billing/refund-payments.md) in the Order Billing API instead. > + Gift card and membership payments only support the `APPROVED` and `VOIDED` statuses. > + The order's `paymentStatus` is recalculated asynchronously after the call.

actions.name: update_fulfillment
actions.description: Update fulfillment. Updates a fulfillment's properties.  To update a field's value, include the new value in the `fulfillment` field in the body params.  > **Notes:** > + `trackingInfo.trackingNumber` and `trackingInfo.shippingProvider` can be updated but not removed. > + When updating `lineItems`, each line item must include an explicit `quantity`. `lineItems` can't be emptied. > + Line items can't be updated for a fulfillment with `completed: true`. > + A shipping notification email may be sent to the buyer when the tracking info changes, depending on the site's email settings.

fulfillment.description: A fulfillment represents the shipment or delivery of some or all of an order's line items.

shippingProvider.description: Shipping provider name. Specify a predefined provider to have `trackingLink` generated automatically, or any other name for a custom provider.  Predefined providers: + `"fedex"`: FedEx. + `"ups"`: UPS. + `"usps"`: United States Postal Service. + `"dhl"`: DHL. + `"canadaPost"`: Canada Post. + `"hermes"`: Hermes.  For a custom provider, specify `trackingLink` yourself. It isn't generated.

trackingLink.description: URL where customers can track the shipment.  When you don't specify `trackingLink` and `shippingProvider` is a predefined provider, the URL is generated from `trackingNumber` in the carrier's tracking URL format. For a custom provider, specify the URL of the carrier's tracking page.

fieldsData.description: Custom fulfillment info in key:value form.

id.description: Line item GUID (mirrors the GUID of the order line item).

quantity.description: Line item quantity.  If the order doesn't have enough unfulfilled units of this line item, the fulfillment isn't created and an error is returned.  Default: When creating a fulfillment, the line item's remaining unfulfilled quantity.

status.description: The current status of the fulfillment process.  Supported values (case-sensitive, any other value is rejected): + `"Pending"` - Initial state when fulfillment is created but processing hasn't started. + `"Accepted"` - Order has been received and validated for fulfillment. + `"Ready"` - Items have been picked and packed, ready for shipping. + `"In_Delivery"` - Items have been handed over to the shipping carrier. + `"Fulfilled"` - Delivery has been completed successfully.  The status typically progresses from `Pending` to `Accepted`, `Ready`, `In_Delivery`, and finally `Fulfilled`. Update the status manually or automatically depending on your fulfillment workflow.  This field is informational. The order's `fulfillmentStatus` is primarily derived from the fulfilled line item quantities, not from this field.

completed.description: Whether the fulfillment is complete.  When `false`, the fulfillment's line items don't count as fulfilled when the order's `fulfillmentStatus` is calculated. When not set, they count as fulfilled.  Line items can't be updated in a fulfillment where `completed` is `true`.

For these orders, the returned list of fulfillments is empty. To learn how to find when these orders were fulfilled, see [Get the date an order was fulfilled](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/orders/orders/sample-flows.md#get-the-date-an-order-was-fulfilled).

If no tax region is found for the line item's address then no tax will be calculated for this line item.  The tax is calculated by a tax calculator app installed on the site. Call List Tax Calculators to see which tax calculators are available. To provide your own tax calculations, use the Tax Calculation service plugin. To create or update tax details for multiple contacts in a single API call, call [Bulk Upsert Contact Tax Details](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/extensions/tax/contact-tax-details/bulk-upsert-contact-tax-details.md).

contactTaxDetails.description: Contact tax details hold the tax-related information for a single contact, keyed by the contact's GUID. Their main purpose is to associate a contact with a tax exempt group, so that the contact receives the group's tax exemption automatically at checkout.  Each contact's tax details map the contact to at most one tax exempt group. During tax calculation, the buyer's contact GUID resolves their tax details, and if `taxExemptGroupId` is set, the matching exemption is applied and reported as an exempt amount in the tax breakdown.  Contacts are typically added to a group by a site owner in the dashboard, or by a VAT-validation app, such as Exemptify, that verifies a customer's VAT GUID at checkout and then associates the contact with the relevant exempt group. Once associated, later checkouts by the same contact are exempt without re-entering the VAT GUID.

taxExemptGroupId.description: GUID of the tax exempt group the contact is associated with. Setting this value makes the contact eligible for the group's tax exemption at checkout.

contactDetails.description: The contact's details, such as name, email, and VAT GUID.  Returned only when `CONTACT_DETAILS` is passed to the `fields` array in the request.

extendedFields.description: Custom field data for the contact tax details.  [Extended fields](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/extensions/backend-extensions/schema-plugins/about-schema-plugin-extensions.md) must be configured in the app dashboard before they can be accessed with API calls.

actions.description: Create tax exempt group. Creates a tax exempt group.  Creating a tax exempt group only defines the group. To create multiple tax exempt groups in a single API call, call [Bulk Create Tax Exempt Groups](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/extensions/tax/tax-exempt-groups/bulk-create-tax-exempt-groups.md).

Instead of exempting each customer individually, you create a group, such as "Resellers" or "Non-profits", give it reduced or zero override rates, and then associate customers with it through their contact tax details.  When a customer that belongs to a tax exempt group checks out, tax calculation resolves the group and applies its exemption, reporting the reduced tax as an exempt amount in the tax breakdown.  A group's override rates are stored per tax group and tax region on the associated manual tax mappings, so exemptions are applied by the Wix manual tax calculator.

actions.name: list_default_tax_exempt_groups
actions.description: List default tax exempt groups. Retrieves the site's default tax exempt groups.  Default tax exempt groups are predefined groups contributed by installed apps, such as a global full-exemption group. They're available on the site without being created through Create Tax Exempt Group, and you can associate contacts with them like any other tax exempt group.

actions.name: get_tax_settings
actions.description: Get tax settings. Retrieves the site's tax settings.  If the site's tax settings have never been set, default values are returned.

actions.name: upsert_tax_settings
actions.description: Upsert tax settings. Creates or updates the site's tax settings.  If the site's tax settings don't exist yet, this method creates them. Otherwise, it updates the existing settings.  Since these settings are shared across all Wix products on the site, changes take effect immediately for all integrated products.

taxSettings.description: Site-level tax settings for a Wix site. Each site has a single tax settings resource.  These settings are shared across all Wix products on the site.

taxIncludedInItemPrices.description: Whether tax is already included in catalog item prices.  When `true`, checkout treats catalog prices as tax-inclusive and doesn't add tax on top. When `false`, tax is calculated and added on top of catalog prices at checkout.  This is a site-level display flag, shared by all Wix products on the site. It doesn't re-price the catalog — catalog prices are unchanged; it only controls whether checkout treats them as already including tax.  Default: `false`

actions.name: create_delivery_profile
actions.description: Create delivery profile. Creates a delivery profile.   A site can have up to 99 delivery profiles. Attempting to exceed this limit returns a `DELIVERY_PROFILES_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` error.

deliveryProfile.description: A delivery profile is a collection of delivery regions that define shipping options for products. Each profile contains delivery regions, which specify where products can be shipped and which carriers can deliver to those destinations.

name.description: Delivery region name. For example, `"Domestic"` or `"International"`.

active.description: Whether this delivery region is active and available during checkout.  Default: `true`

destinations.description: Geographic destinations covered by this region. If empty, the region applies globally (Rest of World). A site can have up to 250 destinations across all delivery profiles.

subdivisions.description: Subdivision codes in [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2) format. For example, `"US-CA"` for California. If empty, the delivery region applies to the entire country.  The following countries don't support subdivision-level delivery and require an empty `subdivisions` list. Sending subdivisions for these countries fails with `SUBDIVISIONS_UNSUPPORTED_FOR_COUNTRY`: `AT`, `BE`, `BS`, `CH`, `CI`, `CZ`, `DO`, `GR`, `NO`, `PL`, `RS`, `SD`, `SI`, `SK`, `SN`.

createdBy.description: Information about who created the delivery profile.  Currently only for use with Wix Restaurants.

appId.description: App GUID, when the delivery profile was created by an external application or Wix service.

userId.description: Wix user GUID, when the delivery profile was created by a Wix user using the dashboard or an API call.

extendedFields.description: Custom field data for the delivery profile object. [Extended fields](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/articles/getting-started/extended-fields.md) must be configured in the app dashboard before they can be accessed with API calls.

namespaces.description: Extended field data. Each key corresponds to the namespace of the app that created the extended fields. The value of each key is structured according to the schema defined when the extended fields were configured.  You can only access fields for which you have the appropriate permissions.  Learn more about [extended fields](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/articles/getting-started/extended-fields.md).

actions.description: Delete delivery profile. Deletes a delivery profile.   Permanently deletes the delivery profile and its delivery regions and carrier configurations. Delivery regions are unique to each profile and aren't shared across profiles. This action can't be undone.  The default delivery profile can't be deleted because every site requires one for core delivery functionality.

description.description: Description of the additional charge. For example, `"Handling fee of $5 applied for gift wrapping"`.

amount.description: Additional fixed charge amount to add to the delivery rate. For example, `"12.50"`.

actions.name: update_delivery_region
actions.description: Update delivery region. Updates a delivery region.   This method doesn't support updating delivery carriers in the region. To manage carriers, use [Add Delivery Carrier](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/shipping-delivery/delivery-profiles/add-delivery-carrier.md), [Update Delivery Carrier](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/shipping-delivery/delivery-profiles/update-delivery-carrier.md), or [Remove Delivery Carrier](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/shipping-delivery/delivery-profiles/remove-delivery-carrier.md).

deliveryRegion.description: A delivery region defines a geographic area and its associated delivery carriers. Each region specifies destinations (countries and subdivisions) where products can be shipped and the carriers available for those deliveries.  During the eCommerce onboarding flow, an "International" region with empty destinations is automatically created. This serves as a "Rest of World" configuration that applies to destinations not explicitly defined in other regions.

name.description: Delivery region name. For example, `"Domestic"` or `"International"`.

active.description: Whether this delivery region is active and available during checkout.  Default: `true`

destinations.description: Geographic destinations covered by this region. If empty, the region applies globally (Rest of World). A site can have up to 250 destinations across all delivery profiles.

subdivisions.description: Subdivision codes in [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2) format. For example, `"US-CA"` for California. If empty, the delivery region applies to the entire country.  The following countries don't support subdivision-level delivery and require an empty `subdivisions` list. Sending subdivisions for these countries fails with `SUBDIVISIONS_UNSUPPORTED_FOR_COUNTRY`: `AT`, `BE`, `BS`, `CH`, `CI`, `CZ`, `DO`, `GR`, `NO`, `PL`, `RS`, `SD`, `SI`, `SK`, `SN`.

revision.description: Delivery profile revision.

actions.name: delivery_profiles_update_extended_fields
actions.description: Update extended fields. Updates extended fields of a delivery profile without incrementing revision.

namespace.description: Identifier for the app whose extended fields are being updated.

namespaceData.description: Data to update. Structured according to the [schema](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/articles/getting-started/extended-fields.md#json-schema-for-extended-fields) defined when the extended fields were configured.

actions.name: get_catalog_version
actions.description: Get catalog version. Retrieves the version of Stores Catalog installed on a site.

actions.name: create_product
actions.description: Create product. Creates a new product.  You can also add a ribbon, brand, info sections, options, and modifiers in the same request.  > **Notes:** > + This method doesn't create inventory items. Use [Create Product With Inventory](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/products-v3/create-product-with-inventory.md) to create a product with inventory in a single call, or create inventory items separately using the [Inventory Items API](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/inventory-items-v3/introduction.md). > + When you create a product with inline options or modifiers (without referencing existing customization GU...

fields.description: Fields to include in the response.

product.description: A product in a Wix Stores catalog.  Products can be physical goods that require shipping, or digital content that customers download. Each product has at least one variant, which represents a specific purchasable version with its own pricing, SKU, and inventory. Products with options (like size or color) have multiple variants.  Products can be associated with brands and ribbons, enhanced with info sections and extended fields, and organized into categories.

physicalProperties.description: Physical properties.  Required when `productType: PHYSICAL`.

pricePerUnit.description: Price per unit settings. > **Note:** Use this field only when relevant. For example, for products that are sold by weight, volume, or length.

quantity.description: Quantity. For example, to define price per per 100 grams, set this field to `100`.

measurementUnit.description: Measurement unit. For example, to define price per 100 grams, set this field to "G".

slug.description: Product slug. A URL-friendly identifier used in the product page address.  If not provided, the slug is autogenerated based on the product name.

description.description: Product description using rich content. > **Note:** Returned only when you pass `"DESCRIPTION"` to the `fields` array in Products API requests. See.md Ricos document reference

nodes.description: Node objects representing a rich content document.

text.description: The text to display on the button.

codeBlockData.description: Data for a code block node.

textStyle.description: Styling for the code block's text.

styles.description: Visual styling for the divider lines.

src.description: The source for the file's data.

options.description: Options for defining the gallery's appearance.

disableExpand.description: Sets whether the gallery's expand button is disabled. Defaults to `false`.

disableDownload.description: Sets whether the gallery's download button is disabled. Defaults to `false`.

original.description: The source of the full size GIF.

downsized.description: The source of the downsized GIF.

gifType.description: Type of GIF (Sticker or NORMAL). Defaults to `NORMAL`.

renderedLevel.description: Rendered heading level for SEO/accessibility, overrides the HTML tag when set.

htmlData.description: Data for an embedded HTML node.

url.description: The URL for the HTML code for the node.

html.description: The HTML code for the node.

widgetId.description: The WixelWidget GUID for AI_WIDGET source nodes.

containerData.description: Styling for the HTML node's container. Height property is irrelevant for HTML embeds when autoHeight is set to `true`.

source.description: The type of HTML code.

autoHeight.description: If container height is aligned with its content height. Defaults to `true`.

link.description: Link details for images that are links.

disableExpand.description: Sets whether the image expands to full screen when clicked. Defaults to `false`.

disableDownload.description: Sets whether the image's download button is disabled. Defaults to `false`.

decorative.description: Sets whether the image is decorative and does not need an explanation. Defaults to `false`.

crop.description: Non-destructive crop rectangle, expressed as fractions (0-1) of the original image. When omitted, the full image is shown.

cropShape.description: Optional shape mask applied to the visible crop. Supported values: CIRCLE, OVAL, STAR, PENTAGON, HEXAGON, TRIANGLE, HEART, RHOMBUS, FLUID, WINDOW.

linkPreviewData.description: Data for a link preview node.

containerData.description: Styling for the link preview's container.

html.description: The preview content as HTML.

layout.description: Layout settings for the poll and voting options.

design.description: Styling for the poll and voting options.

textData.description: Data for a text node. Used to apply decorations to text.

text.description: The text to apply decorations to.

decorations.description: The decorations to apply.

appEmbedData.description: Data for an app embed node.

bookingData.description: Data for embedded Wix Bookings content.

eventData.description: Data for embedded Wix Events content.

type.description: The type of Wix App content being embedded.

itemId.description: The GUID of the embedded content.

name.description: The name of the embedded content.

url.description: The URL for the embedded content.

image.description: An image for the embedded content.

hideDescription.description: Whether to hide the description (Event and Booking).

hideDateTime.description: Whether to hide the date and time (Event).

containerData.description: Styling for the app embed's container.

pricingData.description: Pricing data for embedded Wix App content.

disableDownload.description: Sets whether the video's download button is disabled. Defaults to `false`.

options.description: Video options.

containerData.description: Styling for the oEmbed node's container.

src.description: Origin asset source.

collapsibleListData.description: Data for a collapsible list node.

containerData.description: Styling for the collapsible list's container.

expandOnlyOne.description: If `true`, only one item can be expanded at a time. Defaults to `false`.

initialExpandedItems.description: Sets which items are expanded when the page loads.

direction.description: The direction of the text in the list. Either left-to-right or right-to-left.

isQapageData.description: If `true`, The collapsible item will appear in search results as an FAQ.

rowHeader.description: Sets whether the table's first row is a header. Defaults to `false`.

columnHeader.description: Sets whether the table's first column is a header. Defaults to `false`.

cellSpacing.description: The spacing between cells in pixels. Defaults to `0`.

cellPadding.description: Padding in pixels for cells. Follows CSS order: top, right, bottom, left.

tableCellData.description: Data for a table cell node.

cellStyle.description: Styling for the cell's background color and text alignment.

colspan.description: Defines how many columns the cell spans. Default: 1.

rowspan.description: Defines how many rows the cell spans. Default: 1.

externalData.description: Data for a custom external node.

fields.description: An unordered map of dynamically typed values.

containerData.description: Styling for the audio node's container.

disableDownload.description: Sets whether the audio node's download button is disabled. Defaults to `false`.

html.description: An HTML version of the audio node.

orderedListData.description: Data for an ordered list node.

bulletedListData.description: Data for a bulleted list node.

blockquoteData.description: Data for a block quote node.

layoutData.description: Data for a layout node. Reserved for future use.

borderColor.description: Border color as a hexadecimal value.

gap.description: Horizontal and vertical gap between columns

cellPadding.description: Padding in pixels for cells. Follows CSS order: top, right, bottom, left

cellVerticalAlignment.description: Vertical alignment for the cell's items.

responsivenessBehaviour.description: Responsiveness behaviour of columns when responsiveness applies. Either stacks or wrappers.

responsivenessBreakpoint.description: Size in pixels when responsiveness_behaviour applies

designTarget.description: Defines where selected design propertied applies to

banner.description: Where this layout sits: an edge banner, or the paywall cut. One field, so the two can never be combined.

topDivider.description: Shape divider at the top edge of the layout.

bottomDivider.description: Shape divider at the bottom edge of the layout.

colSpan.description: Size of the cell in 12 columns grid.

link.description: Link details for shapes that are links.

altText.description: Alternate text describing the link's purpose for accessibility. Applies only when `link` is set.

tocData.description: Data for a table of contents node.

includedHeadings.description: Heading levels included in the table of contents. Default: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].

fontSize.description: Optional override for the font size in pixels.

itemSpacing.description: Optional override for the vertical spacing between items in pixels.

color.description: Optional override for the text color.

smartBlockData.description: Data for a smart block node.

type.description: The type of the smart block.

orientation.description: Layout orientation. HORIZONTAL or VERTICAL. Optional for variants with fixed orientation.

columnSize.description: Column size controlling cells per row.

borderColor.description: Border color (for SOLID_JOINED_BOXES variant).

borderWidth.description: Border width in pixels (for SOLID_JOINED_BOXES variant).

borderRadius.description: Border radius in pixels (for SOLID_JOINED_BOXES variant).

smartBlockCellData.description: Data for a smart block cell node.

label.description: Optional label text for the cell (e.g., for stats variants).

borderColor.description: Border color of the cell.

type.description: The type of the parent smart block (must match parent).

accentColor.description: Accent color for non-background variants (e.g., line, bullet, label color).

backgroundColor.description: Background color for background-based variants (SOLID_BOXES, SOLID_BOXES_ALTERNATING, SOLID_JOINED_BOXES).

shapeColor.description: Shape fill color as a hexadecimal value.

checkboxListData.description: Data for a checkbox list node.

listItemData.description: Data for a list item node.

checked.description: Checkbox list item state. Defaults to `false`.

markerStyle.description: Styling of the list item's marker (bullet or number), independent of the item's text. Unset properties follow the item's text.

integrationType.description: Integration type, for example `wix.forms.form`. Used to render the slot in the editor and viewer.

resourceId.description: GUID of the resource the slot renders, for example a form GUID. Passed as-is to the integration.

design.description: Design overrides for this slot. Unset colours use the Ricos theme; unset sizes default to 0.

type.description: Node type. Use `APP_EMBED` for nodes that embed content from other Wix apps. Use `EMBED` to embed content in [oEmbed](https://oembed.com/) format.

nodes.description: A list of child nodes.

style.description: Padding and background color styling for the node.

paddingTop.description: The top padding value in pixels.

paddingBottom.description: The bottom padding value in pixels.

backgroundColor.description: The background color as a hexadecimal value.

documentStyle.description: Global styling for header, paragraph, block quote, and code block nodes in the object.

decorations.description: The decorations to apply to the node.

nodeStyle.description: Padding and background color for the node.

lineHeight.description: Line height for text in the node.

plainDescription.description: Product description in HTML.  + When provided on create/update, this string must be valid HTML. It's then converted to rich content. + `plainDescription` is ignored when a value is also passed to the `description` field. > **Note:** Returned only when you pass `"PLAIN_DESCRIPTION"` to the `fields` array in Products API requests.

visible.description: Whether the product is visible to site visitors.  Default: `true`  > **Note:** For products without options, updating this field automatically > updates the default variant's visibility to match. > For products with options, the product and variant visibility values are independent.

visibleInPos.description: Whether the product is visible in POS (point of sale).  Default: `true` > **Note:** Always `false` for `productType: DIGITAL`.

media.description: Product media items. For a detailed explanation of product media, see [About Product Media](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/products-v3/about-product-media.md).

itemsInfo.description: All media items. > **Note:** Returned only when you pass `"MEDIA_ITEMS_INFO"` to the `fields` array in Products API requests.

items.description: All media items associated with this product.  The first item in the array is automatically set as the product's main media.

id.description: Set media by GUID of an existing file in Wix Media Manager.

url.description: Set media using an external media URL.

displayName.description: Media display name.  Overrides the default media name. Can be passed only when the media is set by a URL in this item's `url` field.

thumbnail.description: Media thumbnail. > **Note:** Returned only when you pass `"THUMBNAIL"` to the `fields` array in Products API requests.

tags.description: The tags rendered into <head>, in no particular order. Render order is decided by the renderer, not by position in this list.  No maxSize: this list is already populated by data written years ago, and a bound added now could reject a page that is already stored.

props.description: Legacy. Was an untyped bag of HTML attributes. Typed replacement: `SeoSchemaV2.TitleTag` / `MetaTag` / `LinkTag`.

meta.description: Legacy. Was an untyped bag of 16 mixed-purpose keys. In `SeoSchemaV2` its contents are split by purpose: per-page structured-data state moves to StructuredDataTag, authorship to `written_by`, and render-time preset logic (variants, enabledByExperiment, removeSchemaIf*) moved out of the stored document entirely — it belongs to the preset definition, not to the page. See the design log for the full key-by-key mapping.

children.description: Legacy. Was the tag's inner content, doubling as the JSON-LD payload for script tags. Typed replacement: `SeoSchemaV2.TitleTag.text` and `StructuredDataTag.json_ld`. No length limit, for the same reason as `type` above.

custom.description: Whether the tag is a [custom tag](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-additional-meta-tags-to-your-sites-pages) — i.e. an entry from the site's Advanced/Custom Tags list.  Setting this to `true` on a write restricts which `type` values are accepted — the same restriction the Advanced/Custom Tags UI enforces. `title` and `script` tags (including JSON-LD structured data) must be sent with `custom` omitted or `false`; sending them with `custom: true` is rejected with `TAG_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED`.  Note this is a separate restriction from Site SEO Tags' own type restriction on `SiteSeoTags.tags`: even with `custom` unset, Site SEO Tags rejects `script` (e.g. for site-wide structured data) unconditionally. There is currently no way to set site-wide, every-page structured data through any of these APIs — write a per-page `script` tag through the Item SEO Tags API instead.  This flag is scoped to that feature only. It is NOT an indicator of whether a standard tag (`title`, `description`, Open Graph, etc.) reflects a manually configured value versus a computed default/pattern — standard tags always resolve with `custom: false`, even when their content comes from a page's manually saved SEO title/description override. Don't use this field to verify whether a live page reflects a manual per-page SEO edit.  Limitation: when `ResolveStaticPageSeoTags` is called without `seoData`, the per-page SEO data is read only from the Vibe/Wix-managed-headless override store. That store holds nothing for classic Wix Editor or Wix Studio pages, so even genuine Advanced/Custom Tags saved on those pages are missing from the response entirely — there, `false` means this API could not tell, not that no custom tag exists. Pass `seoData` explicitly to resolve against a known set of tags.  `SeoSchemaV2.Tag` expresses this as `written_by = USER_CUSTOM`.

disabled.description: Whether the tag is excluded from the rendered <head>.  A disabled tag is still stored, so the user can re-enable it and so a pattern-provided tag stays suppressed on this page. Default false.

settings.description: Page-level SEO settings that are not themselves tags.

preventAutoRedirect.description: Whether to suppress the automatic redirect from this page's previous URL to its current one after a slug change.  Default false, meaning the redirect IS created. The field is named for the exception rather than the rule, which reads backwards; kept as-is because renaming a stored boolean is not worth the migration.

keywords.description: Keyword terms the user is targeting for this page. Used by the SEO assistant and checklist; never rendered into <head>.  20 is a sanity bound, not the product limit. v1 declared 5 — the number the panel happens to allow today — which is exactly the mistake we are fixing for structured data. A product decision to allow 8 should not need a proto release, so the panel owns that number and the proto only stops something absurd.

term.description: The term itself, e.g. "trail running shoes".  No maxLength, for the same reason as the legacy tag fields: keywords are already stored, and a bound added now could reject a record written before the bound existed. The flynt `missing-string-validations` warning on this field is accepted deliberately.

isMain.description: Whether this is the page's primary focus keyword. At most one per page.

origin.description: Which surface added the term, e.g. a panel or a suggestion flow. Used for attribution in BI. Opaque to the renderer.

taxGroupId.description: [Tax group GUID](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/extensions/tax/tax-groups/introduction.md). Used to apply specific tax rates to products.

options.description: Product options, such as "Size" or "Color". Options define the ways a product can vary.  When you provide options, you must also provide the corresponding variants. Each variant must have exactly one choice for each option. For more information, see [About Product Options and Variants](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/about-product-options-and-variants.md).  Options are stored as reusable [customization](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/customizations-v3/introduction.md) entities. Pass an existing customization's GUID to reuse it, or define options inline and new customization entities are created automatically.

choices.description: List of available choices for the option.

id.description: GUID of a customization with `customizationType: PRODUCT_OPTION`.

modifiers.description: Product modifiers. Collect additional information from customers without creating variants.  Unlike options, modifiers don't affect inventory or create additional variants. Use them for things like gift messages or engraving text. For more information, see [About Product Options and Variants](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/about-product-options-and-variants.md).  Modifiers are stored as reusable [customization](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/customizations-v3/introduction.md) entities. Pass an existing customization's GUID to reuse it, or define modifiers inline and new customization entities are created automatically.

defaultAddedPrice.description: Default amount to be added to the product's price.

title.description: Title of the text to be input by the customer.

id.description: GUID of a customization with `customizationType: MODIFIER`.

mandatory.description: Whether customer input is required for this modifier.  If not set, the modifier's `defaultMandatory` value applies.

brand.description: Product [brand](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/brands-v3/introduction.md).  + Pass `brand.name` to add a new brand while creating a product. + Pass an existing brand's `id` to assign that brand to the product.

infoSections.description: Product [info section](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/info-sections-v3/introduction.md).  + Pass `infoSection.uniqueName`, `infoSection.title`, and `infoSection.description` to add a new info section while creating a product. + Pass an existing info section's `id` or `uniqueName` to assign that info section to the product.

uniqueName.description: Info section unique name. > **Note:** Returned only when you pass `"INFO_SECTION"` to the `fields` array in Products API requests.

plainDescription.description: Info section description in HTML.  When provided on create/update, this string must be a valid HTML. It will then be converted to rich content. `plainDescription` is ignored when value is also passed to the `description` field. > **Note:** Returned only when you pass `"INFO_SECTION_PLAIN_DESCRIPTION"` to the `fields` array in Products API requests.

ribbon.description: Primary [ribbon](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/ribbons-v3/introduction.md) displayed on the product. Use `additionalRibbons` to assign further ribbons beyond the primary one.  + Pass `ribbon.name` to add a new ribbon while creating a product. + Pass an existing ribbon's `id` or `name` to assign that ribbon to the product.

mainCategoryId.description: The GUID of the product's primary direct [category](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/categories/introduction.md), which defines the product's breadcrumbs path. For example, if the product's main category is "T-Shirts" (which is a subcategory of "Clothing"), the breadcrumbs path will be "Clothing > T-Shirts".

productType.description: Product type: `PHYSICAL` for tangible goods that require shipping, `DIGITAL` for downloadable content, or `FIXED_BUNDLE` for a bundle whose products the merchant selects.  When passing `productType: PHYSICAL`, you must also pass `physicalProperties`. When passing `productType: DIGITAL`, attach a file by uploading it using [Generate File Upload URL](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/assets/media/media-manager/files/generate-file-upload-url.md) and passing the resulting `file.id` from the upload response as `digitalProperties.digitalFile.id` in each variant. A digital product created without a file cannot be sold. When passing `productType: FIXED_BUNDLE`, you must also pass `fixedBundleProperties`.

variantsInfo.description: Product variants. Each variant represents a specific purchasable version of a product defined by option choices.  Each variant must reference all product options via its `choices` array, using `optionChoiceNames` in requests. You must explicitly provide each variant when creating products with options.  For more information, see [About Product Options and Variants](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/about-product-options-and-variants.md).

physicalProperties.description: Physical properties. Must be passed when `productType: PHYSICAL`

weight.description: Variant shipping weight. product.physicalProperties.shipping_weight_range values are taken from here.

pricePerUnit.description: Price per unit info, in order to show price per unit on the product page. For example if one sells cheese and defines 100g here then we know that buying this variant buyer receives 100g of cheese. But on product page price will be displayed for units defined on product level. See `pricePerUnit.value` to understand how it's calculated.

productDimensions.description: Product dimensions (length, width, height of the physical product).

packageDimensions.description: Package dimensions (length, width, height of the shipping package).

digitalProperties.description: Digital properties. Must be passed when `productType: DIGITAL`.  To attach a file, upload it using [Generate File Upload URL](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/assets/media/media-manager/files/generate-file-upload-url.md) and pass the resulting `file.id` from the upload response as `digitalProperties.digitalFile.id`. A variant without `digitalFile` set cannot be sold.

digitalFile.description: Digital file which will be downloaded by the buyer after successful purchase. Each variant can have a different digital file, allowing you to offer different content per variant.  `digitalFile.id` is a Media Manager file GUID — upload the file via [Generate File Upload URL](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/assets/media/media-manager/files/generate-file-upload-url.md) and use the `file.id` from the upload response.

visible.description: Whether the variant is visible to site visitors.  Default: `true`  > **Note:** For products without options, updating this field automatically > updates the product's visibility to match. > For products with options, the product and variant visibility values are independent.

choices.description: List of choices that define this variant. Each variant must have exactly one choice for each product option.  Use `optionChoiceNames` in all requests where this field is required. For products without options, this array is empty, representing a single "default variant".  For more information, see [About Product Options and Variants](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/about-product-options-and-variants.md).

actualPrice.description: Variant's current selling price. Must be greater than or equal to 0.

compareAtPrice.description: Original price before any discount, shown with a strikethrough in the UI of Wix sites. Only set this if a discount applies. When set, it should be higher than `actualPrice` to reflect savings.

revenueDetails.description: Variant revenue details.  > **Note:** Returned only when the following conditions are met: > + You pass `"MERCHANT_DATA"` to the `fields` array in Products API requests. > + Your app has the required `SCOPE.STORES.PRODUCT_READ_ADMIN` permission scope.

purchaseEligibility.description: Purchase eligibility settings for the product.

userCriteria.description: Criteria a buyer must meet to purchase the product.

additionalRibbons.description: Additional [ribbons](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/ribbons-v3/introduction.md) displayed on the product, beyond the primary `ribbon`.  Use this field to highlight multiple product attributes at once, for example combining a "New" ribbon with a "Sale" ribbon. Both the primary and additional ribbons are rendered on product cards and on the product page.  Each entry follows the same assignment rules as `ribbon`: + Pass `additionalRibbons.name` to add a new ribbon while creating or updating the product. + Pass an existing ribbon's `id` or `name` to assign that ribbon to the product.  A ribbon can be assigned to a product at most once: the same ribbon can't appear more than once in `additionalRibbons`, and a ribbon set as `ribbon` can't also appear in `additionalRibbons`.  Supports up to 4 additional ribbons per product.

extendedFields.description: Custom extended fields for the product object.  [Extended fields](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/extensions/backend-extensions/schema-plugins/about-schema-plugin-extensions.md) must be configured in the app dashboard before they can be accessed with API calls.

namespaces.description: Extended field data. Each key corresponds to the namespace of the app that created the extended fields. The value of each key is structured according to the schema defined when the extended fields were configured.  You can only access fields for which you have the appropriate permissions.  Learn more about [extended fields](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/articles/getting-started/extended-fields.md).

tags.description: Tags assigned to the product, organized into public and private tags.

privateTags.description: Tags that require an additional permission in order to access them, normally not given to site members or visitors.

publicTags.description: Tags that are exposed to anyone who has access to the labeled entity itself, including site members and visitors.

subscriptionDetails.description: Product subscriptions.  Subscription discounts are defined at the product level but apply to each variant's `actualPrice`. This means the final subscription price varies per variant based on the variant's base price.

autoRenewal.description: Whether subscription is renewed automatically at the end of each period. Cannot be `false`, instead set `billingCycles`.

billingCycles.description: Number of billing cycles before subscription ends.

visible.description: Whether the subscription is visible to site visitors.  Default: `true`

frequency.description: Frequency of recurring payment. For example, if `frequency: MONTH` and `billingCycles: 6`; payment will be made monthly for 6 months.

Each inventory item can track stock using either `quantity` (for exact stock counts) or `inStock` (for simple availability). If `inventoryItem` isn't provided, no inventory items are created.  You can also add a ribbon, brand, info sections, options, and modifiers in the same request.  Learn more about [inventory management](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/about-inventory-management.md) including tracking methods, preorder settings, and multi-loca...

physicalProperties.description: Physical properties.  Required when `productType: PHYSICAL`.

It's then converted to rich content. + `plainDescription` is ignored when a value is also passed to the `description` field. > **Note:** Returned only when you pass `"PLAIN_DESCRIPTION"` to the `fields` array in Products API requests.

visible.description: Whether the product is visible to site visitors.  Default: `true`

visibleInPos.description: Whether the product is visible in POS (point of sale).  Default: `true` > **Note:** Always `false` for `productType: DIGITAL`.

itemsInfo.description: All media items. > **Note:** Returned only when you pass `"MEDIA_ITEMS_INFO"` to the `fields` array in Products API requests.

tags.description: The tags rendered into <head>, in no particular order. Render order is decided by the renderer, not by position in this list.  No maxSize: this list is already populated by data written years ago, and a bound added now could reject a page that is already stored.

props.description: Legacy. Was an untyped bag of HTML attributes. Typed replacement: `SeoSchemaV2.TitleTag` / `MetaTag` / `LinkTag`.

meta.description: Legacy. Was an untyped bag of 16 mixed-purpose keys. In `SeoSchemaV2` its contents are split by purpose: per-page structured-data state moves to StructuredDataTag, authorship to `written_by`, and render-time preset logic (variants, enabledByExperiment, removeSchemaIf*) moved out of the stored document entirely — it belongs to the preset definition, not to the page. See the design log for the full key-by-key mapping.

children.description: Legacy. Was the tag's inner content, doubling as the JSON-LD payload for script tags. Typed replacement: `SeoSchemaV2.TitleTag.text` and `StructuredDataTag.json_ld`. No length limit, for the same reason as `type` above.

custom.description: Whether the tag is a [custom tag](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-additional-meta-tags-to-your-sites-pages) — i.e. an entry from the site's Advanced/Custom Tags list.  Setting this to `true` on a write restricts which `type` values are accepted — the same restriction the Advanced/Custom Tags UI enforces. `title` and `script` tags (including JSON-LD structured data) must be sent with `custom` omitted or `false`; sending them with `custom: true` is rejected with `TAG_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED`.  Note this is a separate restriction from Site SEO Tags' own type restriction on `SiteSeoTags.tags`: even with `custom` unset, Site SEO Tags rejects `script` (e.g. for site-wide structured data) unconditionally. There is currently no way to set site-wide, every-page structured data through any of these APIs — write a per-page `script` tag through the Item SEO Tags API instead.  This flag is scoped to that feature only. It is NOT an indicator of whether a standard tag (`title`, `description`, Open Graph, etc.) reflects a manually configured value versus a computed default/pattern — standard tags always resolve with `custom: false`, even when their content comes from a page's manually saved SEO title/description override. Don't use this field to verify whether a live page reflects a manual per-page SEO edit.  Limitation: when `ResolveStaticPageSeoTags` is called without `seoData`, the per-page SEO data is read only from the Vibe/Wix-managed-headless override store. That store holds nothing for classic Wix Editor or Wix Studio pages, so even genuine Advanced/Custom Tags saved on those pages are missing from the response entirely — there, `false` means this API could not tell, not that no custom tag exists. Pass `seoData` explicitly to resolve against a known set of tags.  `SeoSchemaV2.Tag` expresses this as `written_by = USER_CUSTOM`.

disabled.description: Whether the tag is excluded from the rendered <head>.  A disabled tag is still stored, so the user can re-enable it and so a pattern-provided tag stays suppressed on this page. Default false.

settings.description: Page-level SEO settings that are not themselves tags.

preventAutoRedirect.description: Whether to suppress the automatic redirect from this page's previous URL to its current one after a slug change.  Default false, meaning the redirect IS created. The field is named for the exception rather than the rule, which reads backwards; kept as-is because renaming a stored boolean is not worth the migration.

keywords.description: Keyword terms the user is targeting for this page. Used by the SEO assistant and checklist; never rendered into <head>.  20 is a sanity bound, not the product limit. v1 declared 5 — the number the panel happens to allow today — which is exactly the mistake we are fixing for structured data. A product decision to allow 8 should not need a proto release, so the panel owns that number and the proto only stops something absurd.

term.description: The term itself, e.g. "trail running shoes".  No maxLength, for the same reason as the legacy tag fields: keywords are already stored, and a bound added now could reject a record written before the bound existed. The flynt `missing-string-validations` warning on this field is accepted deliberately.

isMain.description: Whether this is the page's primary focus keyword. At most one per page.

origin.description: Which surface added the term, e.g. a panel or a suggestion flow. Used for attribution in BI. Opaque to the renderer.

taxGroupId.description: [Tax group GUID](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/extensions/tax/tax-groups/introduction.md). Used to apply specific tax rates to products.

options.description: Product options, such as "Size" or "Color". Options define the ways a product can vary.  When you provide options, you must also provide the corresponding variants. Each variant must have exactly one choice for each option. For more information, see [About Product Options and Variants](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/about-product-options-and-variants.md).  Options are stored as reusable [customization](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/customizations-v3/introduction.md) entities. Pass an existing customization's GUID to reuse it, or define options inline and new customization entities are created automatically.

choices.description: List of available choices for the option.

id.description: GUID of a customization with `customizationType: PRODUCT_OPTION`.

modifiers.description: Product modifiers. Collect additional information from customers without creating variants.  Unlike options, modifiers don't affect inventory or create additional variants. Use them for things like gift messages or engraving text. For more information, see [About Product Options and Variants](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/about-product-options-and-variants.md).  Modifiers are stored as reusable [customization](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/stores/catalog-v3/customizations-v3/introduction.md) entities. Pass an existing customization's GUID to reuse it, or define modifiers inline and new customization entities are created automatically.

defaultAddedPrice.description: Default amount to be added to the product's price.

title.description: Title of the text to be input by the customer.

mandatory.description: Whether customer input is required for this modifier.  If not set, the modifier's `defaultMandatory` value applies.
